faq.a: Idrissa is associated with the Arabic form إِدْرِيس, whose core sense is idrissa; idris (a prophet in the quran).

faq.q: What is the origin of Idrissa?
faq.a: Idrissa is associated with Arabic. Idrissa is the West African form of Arabic إِدْرِيس (Idrīs), the name of a prophet mentioned in the Quran.
Yes — the underlying form إِدْرِيس is Arabic.
Idrissa can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Idrissa should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Idrīs occurs in the Quran as the name of a prophet.

faq.q: What does Idrissa mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Idrissa is rendered ادریس and carries the sense ادریس، قرآن میں نبی.

faq.q: What does Idrissa mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Idrissa is rendered ادریس and carries the sense ادریس، پیامبر قرآنی.
A romanized syllable approximation is id-ris-sa. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Idrissa?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Idrissa, idrissa. Script forms are إِدْرِيس, ادريس, ادریس, इदरीस.

faq.q: Is Idrissa a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
